title: The Rise of Temujin
description: 1186-1206. Follow Temujin's unification of the Mongol tribes on the steppe: rescue his wife Borte from the Merkits, forge and then break the alliance with Jamukha, defeat the Naiman confederation, and be proclaimed Genghis Khan at the kurultai. The player begins with a small warband and must grow through raids, alliances, and decisive battles.

anachronisms_found: Tayang Khan of the Naiman is represented by the generic KING unit — a crowned Western European monarch model, entirely wrong for a steppe confederation chief; a Mongol cavalry-archer or the Khan-type unit would have been closer at no cost

GUARD_TOWER x2 in the enemy camp: the Merkit/Naiman were nomadic pastoralists with no stone fortification tradition on the 12th-century steppe; the yurts placed alongside them make the towers doubly incongruous

The player hero is the GENGHIS_KHAN unit from 1186 onward, yet the narrative correctly states the title was only conferred at the 1206 kurultai — a self-contradiction in the scenario's own framing (engine-forced, so minor)
ARCHERY_RANGE and STABLE structures for both sides imply fixed military-production architecture that steppe warbands did not possess
